We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Supply
  
  
Our supply chain is the backbone of our business. It's how we get our trusted products to people all over the world, safely and efficiently. And it's our talented and passionate teams that make this happen. If you're looking for a career in supply chain, there's no better place to be than Reckitt. We offer a variety of exciting opportunities in all areas of the supply chain, from planning and procurement to manufacturing and logistics. You could join our Global Supply Planning team to develop and implement our global supply strategy, or work with our Procurement Centre of Excellence team to negotiate and manage our supplier relationships. Our Manufacturing Excellence team help us improve the efficiency, quality and safety of our manufacturing operations, and our Logistics Excellence team develop new and innovative ways to distribute our products to customers.

Seeking a leadership opportunity where you can mould the future of manufacturing? As a Coordinator at Reckitt, you'll be in the driver's seat, nurturing a team of dedicated factory employees. Your role is pivotal – you'll elevate your team's skill set, ensure the smooth running of our supply operations, and leave a lasting impact on our manufacturing process. We're inviting you to be a cornerstone of our continuous drive for excellence, where your influence will go beyond operations to truly shape our success.

* Oversee the daily operations of our manufacturing teams to meet our ambitious production goals.

The skills for success
  
  
Supply Chain Management, Business Partnership, Collaboration and partnership building, Relationship Management, Business Acumen, Productivity management, Improve business processes, Advanced Analytics, Data Analytics, Supply Chain Planning, Logistics Management.
  
  
What we offer

For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. description:
**Manager – Process Excellence**

**Department: Process Excellence**

**Reporting To: Head – Process Excellence**

**Location: Hosur**

**Role purpose:**

Drive process improvement, standardization, productivity and operational excellence across the plant by developing robust processes, managing improvement projects, strengthening documentation and implementing digital solutions.

**Key responsibilities:**

**1. Process excellence & lean**

• Understand and apply Lean principles by adapting Lean tools, systems and practices to the company's High-Variety, Low-Volume (HVLV) manufacturing environment.

• Identify and eliminate process losses to improve productivity, flow, lead time, quality, cost and resource utilization.

• Drive Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives across the plant.

**2. SOP, work instructions & process documentation**

• Develop and standardize SOPs, Work Instructions and process flows across the complete plant value chain: Order Taking > JO Release > Production Scheduling > RM Issuance > Production > Stock Audit > QC > Packing > Dispatch.

• Define process ownership, checkpoints, documentation requirements and standard formats.

• Ensure SOPs and Work Instructions reflect the actual and improved process.

• Maintain document revision and change control.

• Prepare and maintain the SOP/WI review schedule.

**3. Documentation audit & improvement**

• Establish a mechanism to audit process documentation for completeness, accuracy, timeliness and traceability.

• Identify documentation gaps and coordinate corrective actions with process owners.

• Continuously improve, simplify and standardize documentation.

• Identify opportunities for digitalization of documentation and process records.

• Prepare and maintain the documentation audit schedule.

**4. PEx project planning & execution**

• Maintain a Process Excellence project pipeline covering ongoing, planned and future projects.

• Prioritize projects based on business impact, urgency and feasibility.

• Define project scope, milestones, timelines, owners and expected benefits.

• Track ongoing projects and ensure timely execution and closure.

• Monitor project benefits and ensure sustainability of improvements.

**5. Productivity & process improvement**

• Conduct time studies, process studies, line balancing and capacity analysis.

• Identify bottlenecks and improve manpower and machine utilization.

• Drive improvements in cycle time, throughput, yield, WIP and lead time.

• Support productivity improvement and capacity expansion initiatives.

**6. Data & performance management**

• Analyze operational data to identify improvement opportunities.

• Develop and maintain PEx dashboards and performance metrics.

• Track productivity, OEE, yield, rejection, rework, WIP, lead time and cost.

• Convert data-driven insights into improvement projects.

**7. Digitalization**

• Identify opportunities to digitize manual processes, documentation and data capture.

• Develop digital workflows, dashboards and tracking systems to improve visibility, accuracy and process control.

• Reduce manual data entry and duplicate documentation.

• Work with IT and process owners to implement and sustain digital solutions.

**8. Automation**

• Identify opportunities for process automation, semi-automation and machine/process improvements.

• Support feasibility studies, trials and implementation of automation projects.

• Evaluate automation opportunities based on productivity, quality, cost and ROI.

**9. New process / product support**

• Support NPD and new process implementation through process mapping, capacity study, manpower planning, cycle-time definition and SOP creation.

• Ensure new processes are standardized before implementation.

**Key skills:**

• Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement

• Industrial Engineering

• Process Mapping & Standardization

• Time & Motion Study

• Capacity & Productivity Analysis

• Project Management

• Root Cause Analysis

• Data Analysis

• SOP & Work Instruction Development

• Documentation Management

• Digitalization (Mandatory)

• Automation (Optional)

• Change Management (Optional)

**Key KPIs:**

• Productivity Improvement

• Cost Savings

**Join Vultr**
Vultr is seeking an experienced
**Data Center Physical Security Lead**
person who will play a key role in protecting our
**data centers and critical infrastructure**
. As a Security Lead, you will oversee site-level physical security operations, lead security personnel and vendors, manage access control and surveillance systems, drive risk assessments and incident response, and ensure compliance with security standards. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen our security posture, support critical infrastructure projects, and maintain a safe, secure, and operationally ready environment. If you are passionate about security leadership, risk management, and protecting mission-critical infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The
**Data Center Physical Security Lead**
is responsible for the overall physical security program and day-to-day security operations at assigned Vultr data center and critical infrastructure facilities. This role serves as the primary on-site security point of contact, protecting people, facilities, technology infrastructure, proprietary equipment, and other critical assets.
  
  
The
**Data Center Physical Security Lead**
combines hands-on security operations with program leadership, ensuring that security standards, policies, processes, technology, compliance requirements, and vendor performance are effectively implemented and maintained at the site.
  
  
This position will work closely with the Physical Security PMO, Data Center Operations, Facilities, IT, EHS, HR, Legal, Procurement, customers, colocation providers, security vendors, and other stakeholders. The role is expected to identify risks, drive corrective actions, support security projects, and ensure the site remains operationally ready and aligned with Vultr's physical security standards.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on security professional who can operate effectively in a critical infrastructure environment while also thinking strategically about risk, program maturity, technology, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Physical Security Operations**

* Lead day-to-day physical security operations for assigned data center and critical infrastructure facilities.
* Serve as the primary on-site physical security point of contact for employees, contractors, customers, vendors, and facility partners.
* Enforce physical security policies, standards, procedures, post orders, and site-specific requirements.
* Oversee access control, visitor management, badge issuance, patrols, security monitoring, and protection of critical areas.
* Maintain effective controls to prevent unauthorized access, tailgating, piggybacking, and other physical security violations.
* Ensure security coverage and operational readiness during normal operations, maintenance activities, construction, and special events.
* Conduct routine security walkthroughs, inspections, and physical security assessments.
* Maintain accurate security documentation, logs, records, and shift handovers.

**Security Team & Guard Force Leadership**

* Lead and oversee contract security personnel and/or on-site security resources.
* Establish clear expectations for performance, professionalism, customer service, documentation, and adherence to security procedures.
* Partner with security vendors to ensure staffing, training, post orders, and service levels meet Vultr requirements.
* Monitor guard-force performance and address deficiencies through documented corrective actions.
* Support onboarding, training, drills, tabletop exercises, and ongoing security awareness activities.
* Ensure security personnel are prepared to respond appropriately to incidents and emergencies without unnecessary use of force.

**Security Systems & Technology**

* Oversee the operational effectiveness of electronic physical security systems, including:

+ Electronic Access Control (EAC)
+ CCTV/Video Management Systems (VMS)
+ Intrusion detection
+ Alarm monitoring
+ Biometric and multifactor access systems
+ Intercom and related security technologies

* Review access, video, and alarm activity to identify anomalies, policy violations, and security trends.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance, testing, troubleshooting, and repair of security systems with integrators, vendors, facilities, and internal technical teams.
* Identify system deficiencies and recommend improvements to security technology, barriers, lighting, perimeter controls, and other protective measures.
* Support implementation and operational acceptance of new security technologies and site security systems.

**Risk Management & Physical Security Assessments**

* Conduct regular physical security risk assessments, vulnerability reviews, and site walkthroughs.
* Identify security gaps and develop practical corrective and preventive actions.
* Track security findings through closure and verify that remediation is effective.
* Apply layered security and defense-in-depth principles to site protection.
* Evaluate changes to site operations, construction, equipment, occupancy, or customer requirements for potential physical security impacts.
* Escalate significant risks and unresolved security issues to the Physical Security PMO Lead and appropriate stakeholders.

**Incident Management & Emergency Response**

* Serve as the primary security escalation point for physical security incidents at the assigned site.
* Lead or support response to security incidents, unauthorized access attempts, suspicious activity, security system failures, alarms, facility emergencies, and physical security breaches.
* Act as security incident commander when required and coordinate with internal stakeholders, emergency services, law enforcement, and facility management.
* Support emergency response, evacuation, lockdown, shelter-in-place, business continuity, and crisis management procedures.
* Conduct or support incident investigations and produce clear, timely, and accurate incident reports.
* Identify root causes and track corrective actions resulting from security incidents.
* Participate in emergency drills, tabletop exercises, and incident-response testing.

**Compliance, Audits & Security Documentation**

* Maintain site compliance with applicable physical security requirements, customer obligations, contractual requirements, and industry frameworks.
* Support compliance requirements associated with SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST controls, NIST 800-88, MSA requirements, and other applicable standards.
* Prepare and maintain documentation and evidence required for internal, customer, and third-party audits.
* Conduct periodic access reviews and recertification of physical access rights.
* Maintain accurate records related to badges, visitors, incidents, security inspections, system testing, corrective actions, and security personnel.
* Identify audit findings and coordinate remediation through closure.

**Vendor & Colocation Management**

* Manage day-to-day relationships with contract security providers, security technology integrators, and other physical security vendors.
* Establish and monitor vendor performance against contractual requirements, SLAs, KPIs, and Vultr security standards.
* Partner with colocation and facility providers to ensure building, perimeter, and shared security controls adequately protect Vultr assets and operations.
* Participate in vendor performance reviews, issue resolution, and corrective action planning.
* Escalate vendor or facility security deficiencies when appropriate.

**Security Projects & PMO Support**

* Partner closely with the Physical Security PMO Lead on security projects, site deployments, upgrades, and program initiatives.
* Provide site-level operational requirements and subject-matter expertise for physical security projects.
* Support project planning, implementation, testing, commissioning, and operational handoff of security systems and infrastructure.
* Review project designs, security drawings, technology deployments, and proposed security solutions for operational suitability.
* Identify site-specific security risks or requirements that may not be captured in standard security designs.
* Participate in project meetings with internal teams, customers, contractors, integrators, and facility partners.
* Track site security actions, dependencies, risks, and deliverables through completion.
* Help ensure new or modified facilities meet Vultr physical security standards before operational handoff.

**Asset, Shipment & Media Security**

* Support secure receipt, verification, staging, and handling of inbound technology equipment and critical components.
* Verify shipments against applicable manifests, bills of materials, or documentation.
* Maintain appropriate records within asset tracking or IT asset management systems.
* Ensure equipment and sensitive materials are appropriately secured while awaiting deployment.
* Maintain knowledge of and enforce applicable media storage, handling, and destruction procedures.
* Coordinate with appropriate teams regarding secure media destruction and documentation.

**Reporting & Metrics**

* Provide regular security status updates to the Physical Security PMO Lead and relevant site stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain site security metrics, including incidents, vulnerabilities, corrective actions, system availability, access reviews, audit findings, and vendor performance.
* Produce clear and concise incident reports, risk assessments, security summaries, and management reports.
* Identify trends and recommend actions that improve the effectiveness and maturity of the site security program.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in physical security, corporate security, critical infrastructure security, data center security, law enforcement, military security, or a related field.
* At least 2 years of experience in a lead, supervisory, or program ownership role.
* Experience operating in a data center, critical infrastructure, technology, or high-compliance environment.

* Working knowledge of physical security risk assessment, vulnerability management, and defense-in-depth principles.
* Demonstrated experience managing contract security personnel and security vendors.

* Experience supporting audits and compliance programs.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, operations personnel, executives, vendors, customers, and first responders.
* Ability to work independently and make sound operational decisions within established security policies and procedures.

* Experience with security program metrics, KPIs, and reporting.
* Experience with project management or participation in security technology/infrastructure projects.
* Knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST, and other security/compliance frameworks.
* Training in First Aid/CPR/AED, de-escalation, incident command, ICS/NIMS, or emergency management.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
  
  
We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.

**Value Stream Development**

* Support the COO and operations leadership team in standing up and maturing value streams across manufacturing, sourcing, procurement, and supply chain.
* Lead value stream mapping to understand current-state processes, identify waste, constraints, handoffs, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop future-state value stream designs and actionable improvement roadmaps.
* Establish clear ownership, KPIs, operating rhythms, and accountability within each value stream.
* Help connect procurement, suppliers, manufacturing, inventory, logistics, and customer requirements into an integrated end-to-end operating model.
* Facilitate cross-functional value stream reviews and ensure actions remain on track.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Lead Lean and continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, lead time, inventory, and working capital.
* Identify and prioritize improvement opportunities based on business impact.
* Facilitate Kaizen events, problem-solving sessions, root-cause analysis, process mapping, and improvement workshops.
* Apply Lean methodologies including standard work, visual management, 5S, daily management, problem solving, flow, pull, and waste elimination.
* Build sustainable processes rather than one-time improvements by establishing standards, ownership, measurement, and follow-through.
* Partner with teams to simplify processes and eliminate unnecessary complexity.

**Manufacturing & Operational Excellence**

* Work directly with plant and operations leaders to improve manufacturing flow, productivity, throughput, capacity utilization, and schedule attainment.

* Identify bottlenecks and capacity constraints and develop improvement plans.
* Support improvements in material flow, inventory management, production planning, and shop-floor execution.
* Partner closely with HSEQ and operational leadership to ensure improvements reinforce safe and high-quality operations.

**Sourcing & Procurement Improvement**

* Partner with procurement and sourcing leadership to improve supplier, sourcing, and purchasing processes.
* Evaluate end-to-end procurement workflows, including demand identification, sourcing, purchase orders, supplier performance, material availability, and inventory.
* Help improve supplier lead times, delivery performance, responsiveness, cost, and quality.
* Identify opportunities to simplify purchasing processes, improve visibility, reduce cycle times, and strengthen accountability.
* Support supplier segmentation, performance management, and development initiatives where appropriate.
* Help connect sourcing and procurement priorities directly to manufacturing and value-stream requirements.

**Performance Management & Operating Rhythm**

* Establish practical KPIs and visual management tools that allow teams to quickly understand performance and take action.
* Support daily, weekly, and monthly operating reviews with clear metrics, actions, owners, and deadlines.
* Develop dashboards and reporting for key operational improvement initiatives.
* Track benefits and ensure improvement projects deliver measurable operational and financial results.
* Escalate barriers and risks requiring leadership support.
* Help create a culture where teams use data to identify problems, solve root causes, and continuously improve performance.

**Change Leadership & Capability Building**

* Coach leaders and employees in Lean thinking, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement practices.
* Build continuous improvement capability within the organization rather than creating dependency on the CI function.
* Facilitate cross-functional teams and influence change without relying solely on formal authority.
* Help establish common continuous improvement language, tools, and expectations across global operations.
* Recognize and share successful practices across locations and value streams.

**You bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Demonstrated experience leading Lean, operational excellence, or continuous improvement initiatives in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong experience with value stream mapping and translating findings into practical improvement actions.
* Experience working across manufacturing and supply chain functions; sourcing or procurement experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable improvements in cost, productivity, lead time, quality, inventory, or delivery performance.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience facilitating Kaizen events and cross-functional improvement initiatives.
* Lean Six Sigma certification preferred but not required; demonstrated application and results are more important than certification.
* Experience in an industrial, engineered-product, capital-equipment, or project-based manufacturing environment preferred.
* Comfortable working in a global, matrixed, and rapidly evolving organization.

**Role Description:** 




 The Manager – Purchase \& Procurement will be responsible for end\-to\-end procurement activities for Golden Coir Tufts’ manufacturing operations. The role will manage sourcing, supplier development, commercial negotiations, purchase planning and timely availability of raw materials, packaging materials, chemicals, consumables, engineering spares and other production requirements.
 



  





 The position will work closely with Production, Planning, Stores, Quality, Accounts and Management to ensure uninterrupted material availability while maintaining optimum inventory levels and procurement costs.
 



  





 Key responsibilities include supplier identification and evaluation, RFQ comparison, price and payment\-term negotiation, purchase order management, delivery follow\-up, alternate vendor development, supplier performance monitoring and cost\-reduction initiatives.
 



  





 The role will also monitor material requirements against production plans, lead times and inventory levels; address supplier quality or delivery issues; maintain approved vendor records; and ensure purchasing activities are accurately recorded through the company’s ERP system.
 



  





 The Manager will be expected to continuously identify opportunities for cost reduction, supplier consolidation, alternate sourcing, improved payment terms, reduced lead times and better procurement controls.
 



  





**Qualifications:**

 \* Strong experience in vendor development, RFQ comparison, commercial negotiation and supplier performance management.
 



 \* Experience procuring raw materials, chemicals, polymers/rubber/PVC\-related materials, packaging, consumables or engineering spares is advantageous.
 



 \* Strong understanding of MRP/material planning, stock levels, reorder planning and production\-driven procurement.
 



 \* Proven ability to negotiate pricing, credit/payment terms, MOQ, lead times and supply contracts.
 



 \* Experience working with ERP\-based purchasing, PO, GRN and inventory workflows.
 



 \* Strong Excel/data\-analysis capability for purchase\-price analysis, consumption trends and cost\-saving analysis.
 



 \* Experience handling supplier quality issues, shortages and urgent production requirements.

title: Lead Engineer - Customer Application
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Détient globalement l'activité de contrôle de projet et définit des spécifications fonctionnelles cohérentes et des processus globaux communs pour la mise en œuvre des projets. Activités menées pour mieux comprendre ou répondre à terme aux attentes du client Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**
* Apporte une expertise technique et développe des solutions techniques (configuration, estimation des performances, économie, etc.) dans le cadre du processus pré\-ITO (demande d'achat) tout en assurant l'interface avec l'équipe commerciale. Possède une compréhension approfondie des marchés pertinents et de la valeur économique des clients, ce qui contribue à des stratégies d'adjudication gagnantes. Pour inclure « ITO » : Analyse technique du besoin client : définition et optimisation des produits ; du cadre (description) ; du programme ; du schéma industriel ; des coûts, compte tenu des contrats et politiques internes ainsi que des procédures. Calcul des performances et de l'efficacité des installations, des systèmes et des équipements. Documentation des spécifications techniques et des éléments de coût pour les phases ultérieures d'exécution du contrat. Cela inclut également la partie OTR (« de la commande jusqu'au versement ») où les ingénieurs s'emploient à personnaliser les produits et à les implémenter en fonction des besoins spécifiques des clients.
* Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.
* Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine.
* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions.
* Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe.


**Qualifications De Base**
* 
* Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis \- Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États\-Unis \- Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).


**Caractéristiques souhaitées**
* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États\-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. title: Lead Engineer - Customer Application Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Verantwortung für die globale Projektsteuerungsaktivität und Förderung einheitlicher Funktionsspezifikationen und gemeinsamer globaler Prozesse für die Projektimplementierung. Tätigkeiten, die dazu dienen, die Erwartungen des Kunden besser zu verstehen oder letztendlich zu erfüllen Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung.Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und \-verfahren abgedeckt wird.Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**
* Bietet technisches Know\-how und entwickelt technische Lösungen (Konfiguration, Leistungsschätzung, Wirtschaftlichkeit usw.) im Rahmen des Pre\-ITO\-Prozesses (Beschaffung), und fungiert gleichzeitig als Schnittstelle zum kaufmännischen Team. Verfügt über fundiertes Wissen über die relevanten Märkte und des wirtschaftlichen Werts der Kunden, was zur Gewinnung von Gebotsstrategien beiträgt. Einschließen von "ITO": Technische Analyse des Kundenbedarfs: Definition und Optimierung der Produkte; Umfang (Beschreibung); Zeitplan; industrielle Regelung; Kosten unter Berücksichtigung der vertraglichen und internen Richtlinien und Verfahren. Berechnung der Leistung und Effizienz von Anlagen, Systemen und Ausrüstung. Dokumentation von technischen Spezifikationen und Kalkulationselementen für weitere Phasen der Vertragsabwicklung. Dazu gehört auch der OTR\-Teil, in dem die Ingenieure daran arbeiten, die Produkte anzupassen und für bestimmte Kundenanforderungen umzusetzen
* Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen.
* Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen.Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind.Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.

**Grundqualifikationen**
* Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor\-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).


**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**
* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

title: Quality Manager
description:
**About The Role**
 As Quality Manager, you lead the plant quality function to deliver zero\-defect manufacturing, exceed customer expectations, and ensure compliance with OEM, IATF, and regulatory standards. You drive a culture of continuous improvement by leveraging robust quality systems, data\-driven decision\-making, and disciplined problem\-solving. Through strong leadership and collaboration across manufacturing, engineering, supplier quality, and customer teams, you enable operational excellence in quality performance and customer satisfaction while developing a high\-performing quality organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the site quality function to consistently achieve world\-class quality performance, customer satisfaction, and compliance with OEM and industry standards.
* Champion zero\-defect manufacturing by driving proactive quality planning, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement initiatives across welding and assembly operations.
* Lead customer quality management activities, including customer complaints, audits, issue resolution, and timely closure of corrective actions.
* Ensure effective implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) in compliance with IATF 16949, ISO standards, and customer\-specific requirements.
* Drive defect reduction initiatives through structured problem\-solving methodologies and implementation of Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) reduction strategies.
* Oversee Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Statistical Process Control (SPC), Measurement System Analysis (MSA), Control Plans, and implementation of 7QC tools.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, and systematic containment activities for internal and external quality concerns.
* Partner with manufacturing, engineering, maintenance, supplier quality, and customer teams to resolve quality issues and improve process capability.
* Establish and monitor quality KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems to drive accountability and visibility across the organization.
* Develop and coach a high\-performing quality team, fostering technical excellence, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Ensure compliance with all safety, environmental, regulatory, and customer requirements while promoting operational discipline and best practices.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Production Engineering, Automobile Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 15\+ years of experience in Quality Management within a Tier\-1 automotive manufacturing environment.
* Strong expertise in welding and assembly manufacturing processes and quality management systems.
* Proven experience in customer quality management, audit management, complaint handling, and corrective action implementation.
* Demonstrated knowledge and practical application of IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, SPC, MSA, Control Plans, and core quality tools.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with experience driving defect reductionand continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and influencing stakeholders to achieve quality and business objectives.
* Proficiency in interpreting customer requirements, regulatory standards, and quality system expectations.
* Effective communication, coaching, and leadership skills with a strong ownership mindset and customer focus.
* Relevant quality certifications and automotive quality credentials are preferred.
